capabilities_done: slice 1 (clip colour, Lumetri-style): folio hsk.studio.clip_finishing@1 record set beside the document (StudioDocument/StudioClip unchanged); effect color_grade = STU-COL-160 stage blocks: input LUT and creative look (STU-COL-158 content-digest refs, look_intensity 0..200), basic (STU-COL-220 hard bounds), RGB + five cross-channel curves (STU-COL-225/226), STU-COL-222 wheels (overall/shadow/mid/highlight offset, gamma, gain, contrast, pivot, saturations, splits), secondaries (STU-COL-227 HSL key with soft edges + own temperature/tint -300..300, contrast, saturation), vignette (STU-COL-228); prism grade.rs owns the STU-COL-222/227/228 maths; .cube reuses SMB-DEVELOP-LENS-PRESETS prism CubeLut/parse_cube (tetrahedral), plus an additive CubeLut::write_cube (STU-COL-159 export); composite ClipGrade orders the stages and reuses Pigment PreparedCurve, Curves, Vibrance and rgb_to_hsl/hsl_to_rgb; rendered per texel at the frame through SceneContent::Graded (exactness clip_colour_grade Approximate)

slice 2 (clip effect stack, STU-VID-020/STU-FX-002): entries transform (anchor/position/scale/rotation), opacity, crop, gaussian_blur and pigment_filter (Pigment smart-filter kinds, liquify refused) with StudioKeyedValue streams in clip-local ticks (composition keyframe rules); composite evaluate_effect_stack samples them through motion (keyed_property + Property::sample), apply_effects wraps grade/crop stages and Pigment smart filters over the clip frame and composes transform/opacity onto the layer matrix/opacity; crop = exact box coverage (clip_crop Exact)

slice 3 (titles/graphics, STU-VID-070/070a/070b/070c): StudioMotionTemplate (composition id, ordered exposed controls of the five types source_text/group/colour/checkbox/numeric_slider, required fonts/effects/renderer) and StudioGraphicInstance (clip whose source_ref is Primitive hsk.studio.motion_template@1); folio enforces the HARD source-text font permissions and can_animate; composite instantiate_template patches composition streams and AE shape fill records at a clip tick (text resolved for the caller's shaping) and renders through CompositionTemporalSource; check_template_requirements returns TEMPLATE_REQUIREMENT_UNMET naming missing fonts/effects/renderer

slice 4 (captions, STU-VID-037; STU-VID-085 gap): folio StudioCaptionTrack per document caption track (language, one active track per sequence, segments with text/timing/style, constraints -> display warnings, segments_at); interop-media captions.rs SubRip + WebVTT import/export (exact 254016000 ticks per ms, tokenised tags/entities, NOTE/STYLE/REGION skipped, whole-cue b/i/u/font, an8 / line: / align: placement); composite caption_burn_in lays caller-shaped glyphs out by ink extent (bottom/top, left/centre/right) through the animated-text path
